verdict.rationale: Kimi's core interaction model is natural-language conversation. First-party docs say the Kimi Code Desktop/CLI agent reads code, edits files, runs commands and verifies results "through conversation", and the assistant invites users to "just ask, or do an Agent task" (尽管问，或做个 Agent 任务). Agent-driven web building with multi-round edits is also documented. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation reliability, detailed documentation of what product settings or features can be controlled purely via natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
